purpose: Permanent test definitions. This catalogue is NOT execution evidence.

tests.title: Anonymous visitor cannot read Facilities API
tests.why: Someone who has not signed in must never obtain the Facilities records through a direct link.

tests.title: Anonymous visitor cannot read an Owner register
tests.why: Private Owner form information must remain unavailable to someone who has not signed in.

tests.title: Anonymous visitor is redirected from Facilities pages
tests.why: Typing the Facilities page address must not bypass sign-in.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator reaches Facilities Home
tests.why: Authorised Facilities staff need access to their work area.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator cannot enter Organisation Home
tests.why: Facilities access must not silently grant authority over the entire organisation.

tests.title: Organisation Administrator reaches Organisation Home
tests.why: The approved Organisation role should reach its authorised control area.

tests.title: Centre Manager cannot use generic Facilities API
tests.why: Venue-level access must not automatically allow whole-department data access.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator may read current Facilities API
tests.why: Verify that approved Facilities role is recognised by the server, not just by menus.
